SELECT a.voice, a.process_id AS processId, a.approve_order_id AS approveOrderId, IFNULL(a.process_name,'') AS processName, a.process_name_list as dispatchProcessName, a.next_link_id nextLinkId, a.next_link_name nextLinkName, a.flow_link_type flowLinkType, a.real_link_type realLinkType, IF(a.flow_node_time IS NULL,'',DATE_FORMAT(a.flow_node_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS flowNodeTime, IF(a.flow_end_time IS NULL,'',DATE_FORMAT(a.flow_end_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS flowEndTime, IFNULL(a.remark,'') AS remark, IFNULL(a.close_remark,'') AS closeRemark, a.accept_process_id as acceptProcessId, a.enable_acceptance_mode as enableAcceptanceMode FROM ${tableName} a WHERE a.order_id = #{orderId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.order_flow_id = #{orderFlowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.real_link_type = '5'

SELECT a.process_id AS processId, IFNULL(a.process_name,'') AS processName FROM ${tableName} a WHERE a.order_id = #{orderId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.if_current_link ='0' and link_id =#{linkId} order by a.flow_end_time desc limit 1

SELECT attr.link_id FROM ${processTableName} t LEFT JOIN ${warnTableName} wo on wo.warning_order_id = t.order_id LEFT JOIN vm_flow_link_attr attr on wo.flow_id = attr.alarm_flow_id WHERE t.order_id = #{orderId} AND t.if_current_link = '1' AND t.delete_flag = '0' and attr.rollback_flag = '1' and attr.link_id = t.link_id

SELECT ft.cur_link FROM ${processTableName} t LEFT JOIN ${warnTableName} wo on wo.warning_order_id = t.order_id left JOIN vm_flow_template_link ft ON ft.cur_link = t.link_id and ft.template_id = wo.flow_template LEFT JOIN vm_flow_link_industry_config flic on flic.link_id = ft.cur_link AND flic.industry_code = convert(wo.industry_code using utf8mb4) WHERE t.order_id = #{orderId} AND t.if_current_link = '1' AND t.delete_flag = '0' AND flic.rollback_flag = '1' and flic.status = '1'
